profile.summary:
Hi! 👋🏻 I'm a software engineer at Instagram Labs based in New York City. Currently pathfinding new bets for Instagram.

I am passionate about fun and well crafted software that enables people to create, share, and connect.

In the past I've worked with clients like Walmart's Store No. 8 innovation incubator 🛍, Anheuser-Busch 🍺, Steinway & Sons 🎹, and World Wildlife Fund 🐼.

projects.title: LiveBlend iPhone app
projects.description:
I created the app LiveBlend to be the best way to create double exposure photos on the iPhone. It is simple, clean, and made for everyone from photography novices to professionals.  It displays a preview of the blend effect in real-time; something that had been done only by high-end DSLRs before.

It has been truly amazing to see people, around the world, using something that I have made in ways that I had not imagined. As my first app launch, it has been exciting and fun. There were lessons learned and improvements are continually being made as I find out how users use my app and get their feedback.

The app is written entirely in Objective-C using Xcode. I am still improving it and adding features to it with updates every few weeks.

LiveBlend is on the App Store for $0.99, has been featured on several blogs, and has over 3000 downloads.
